scripts.dev: node scripts/config.ts local-dev && mkdir -p ../web/dist && wrangler dev -c wrangler.local-dev.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/config.ts deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply score3ly --remote -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
